prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same design, items, their order and names. Modular ship kit sheet 2, masts and rigging, reusable rigging modules for skiff, cutter and galleon, in wood with gold fittings and teal pennants, in the same arrangement as the second attached image: left: "Small mast (skiff)", "Medium mast (cutter)", "Tall mast (galleon)" with its crow's nest; top centre: "Yards (square rig)" in three sizes labelled "L – galleon", "M – cutter", "S – skiff"; "Booms & gaffs (fore-and-aft rig)": "Boom", "Gaff"; top right: "Crow's nest", "Weather vane", "Pennant"; bottom: "Rope ladder", "Shrouds (side rigging)", "Ratlines (climbing net)", "Pulleys & blocks": "Single block", "Double block", "Triple block", "Hook block"; "Cleat", "Belaying pins", "Coiled rope". Every rope is thick solid rope, ladders and nets drawn as chunky flat panels whose fine mesh is painted, not modelled. Labels give the piece name only: the ship kit has no measured sizes yet, so write NO dimensions anywhere except "1.8 m" on the scale figure standing beside the masts at true scale (tall mast about 25 m, medium 9.5 m, small about 5 m). No description text, no subtitle. Even flat light, no rim light. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Modular ship kit 2 – masts and rigging".
